label: Ātma-Nivedana Song Five
title: āmāra bolite prabhu āre kichu nāi
metaDescription: Ātma-Nivedana Song Five: (āmāra bolite prabhu āre kichu nāi) of Śaraṇāgati (‘Surrender’) written by Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura in 1893. This songbook contains 50 songs detailing the six symptoms of surrender unto the lotus feet of Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

verses.translation: O Lord, nothing further remains that may be called “mine.” Father, friend, brother-You alone are all these to me.

translit: bandhu, dārā, suta, sutā-tava dāsī dās
sei to’ sambandhe sabe āmāra prayās
verses.translation: My friends, wife, sons and daughters are now Your servants and maidservants. Whatever care I take for them is only as they are related to You.
deva: बन्धु, दारा, सुत, सुता-तव दासी दास्
सेइ तो’ सम्बन्धे सबे आमार प्रयास्
bengali: বন্ধু, দারা, সুত, সুতা-তব দাসী দাস্
সেই তো’ সম্বন্ধে সবে আমার প্রযাস্

translit: rakhā kori āmi mātro sevaka hoiyā
verses.translation: Declaring that my wealth, family members, home, and wife are truly Yours, I continue as a mere servant to dutifully protect them.
deva: रखा कोरि आमि मात्रो सेवक होइया
bengali: রখা কোরি আমি মাত্রো সেবক হোইযা

verses.translation: For the purpose of Your service I will earn money and bear the expense of maintaining Your household.

translit: bhālo-manda nāhi jāni sevā mātro kori
verses.translation: I know nothing of what is good or bad; I simply render my service. I am but a watchman set to guard the properties of Your household.
deva: भालो-मन्द नाहि जानि सेवा मात्रो कोरि
bengali: ভালো-মন্দ নাহি জানি সেবা মাত্রো কোরি

verses.translation: I exercise my senses only according to Your direction, and thus I desire to hear, see, smell, and taste.

translit: nija-sukha lāgi’ kichu nāhi kori ār
verses.translation: I no longer do anything for my own pleasure. Bhaktivinoda says, “Your pleasure is the essence of everything.”
deva: निज-सुख लागि’ किछु नाहि कोरि आर्
bengali: নিজ-সুখ লাগি’ কিছু নাহি কোরি আর্

titleDeva: आमार बोलिते प्रभु आरे किछु नाइ
titleBengali: আমার বোলিতে প্রভু আরে কিছু নাই
